Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('STRG_ITEMS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$LOV_BA_STRG_ITEMS_GLOBALS.STRG_ITEMS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$LOV_BA_STRG_ITEMS_GLOBALS.STRG_ITEMS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$LOV_BA_STRG_ITEMS_GLOBALS.STRG_ITEMS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('STRG_ITEMS.L_BSC_CNTNR_MRK');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_MRK '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_MRK '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_MRK LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(CNTNR_MRK ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(STRD_CNTNR_SEQ), ''CG$NULL''), STRG_REQ_NBR, PORT_CD, STRG_REQ_DT) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(STRD_CNTNR_SEQ), ''CG$NULL''), STRG_REQ_NBR, PORT_CD, STRG_REQ_DT '||'FROM
 BA_STRG_CNTNRS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SRI_VBI_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'MFST_DT,MFST_TYPE,BL_ITEM_SEQ,BL_SEQ,PORT_CD,MFST' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRI_TS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('مسلسل ارسالية منقولة غير صحيح', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRI_SGT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'GDS_TYPE_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRI_PT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PKG_TYPE_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRI_CHNG_BSC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الحاوية البديلة بالايداع', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SRI_BSC_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('مسلسل حاوية غير موجود', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 8.2 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT > 12 AND :PARAMETER.TARIFF_LOV = 0 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('لا يمكن عرض أكثر من 12 صف من البيانات','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT - 12) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT + SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$QRY_STRG_ITEMS_SRI_BSC_FK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$QRY_STRG_ITEMS_SRI_BSC_FK */
PROCEDURE CGFK$QRY_STRG_ITEMS_SRI_BSC_FK(
 P_L_CNTT_CNTNR_TYPE IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :STRG_ITEMS.L_CNTT_CNTNR_TYPE. */
 ,P_L_BSC_CNTNR_TYPE_CD IN OUT NUMBER /* Value in Item :STRG_ITEMS.L_BSC_CNTNR_TYPE_CD. */
 ,P_L_BSC_CNTNR_MRK IN OUT VARCHAR2 /* Value in Item :STRG_ITEMS.L_BSC_CNTNR_MRK. */
 ,P_STRG_REQ_DT IN DATE /* Value in Item :STRG_ITEMS.STRG_REQ_DT. */
 ,P_PORT_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :STRG_ITEMS.PORT_CD. */
 ,P_STRG_REQ_NBR IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :STRG_ITEMS.STRG_REQ_NBR. */
 ,P_STRD_CNTNR_SEQ IN NUMBER ) IS /* Value in Item :STRG_ITEMS.STRD_CNTNR_SEQ. */
/* Query foreign key value/query lookup data. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT L_BSC.CNTNR_MRK
 ,L_BSC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD
 ,L_CNTT.CNTNR_TYPE
 FROM BA_STRG_CNTNRS L_BSC
 ,CNTNR_TYPES L_CNTT
 WHERE (L_BSC.STRD_CNTNR_SEQ = P_STRD_CNTNR_SEQ OR
 (L_BSC.STRD_CNTNR_SEQ IS NULL AND
 P_STRD_CNTNR_SEQ IS NULL ))
 AND L_BSC.STRG_REQ_NBR = P_STRG_REQ_NBR
 AND L_BSC.PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD
 AND L_BSC.STRG_REQ_DT = P_STRG_REQ_DT
 AND L_CNTT.CNTNR_TYPE_CD (+) = L_BSC.CNTNR_TYPE_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO P_L_BSC_CNTNR_MRK
 , P_L_BSC_CNTNR_TYPE_CD
 , P_L_CNTT_CNTNR_TYPE;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: EXTRACT_SEQ
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION EXTRACT_SEQ(V_GLOBAL_SEQ VARCHAR2, V_CURR_SEQ NUMBER) RETURN NUMBER IS
V_STR VARCHAR2(1000):= V_GLOBAL_SEQ ;
V_SEQ NUMBER;
V_RTRN NUMBER ;

BEGIN

 LOOP
 V_SEQ :=TO_NUMBER( SUBSTR(V_STR,1,INSTR(V_STR,',')-1));
 IF V_SEQ = V_CURR_SEQ THEN
 V_RTRN := 1;
 EXIT WHEN 1=1;
 END IF;

 V_STR:= SUBSTR(V_STR,INSTR(V_STR,',')+1,LENGTH(V_STR));

 IF INSTR(V_STR,',') = 0 OR V_STR IS NULL THEN
 IF TO_NUMBER(V_STR) = V_CURR_SEQ THEN
 V_RTRN := 1 ;
 ELSE
 V_RTRN := 0;
 END IF;
 EXIT WHEN 1=1 ;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN V_RTRN ;

END;

PROCEDURE COPY_SELECTED_VALUES IS
MSG_LVL VARCHAR2(5);
BEGIN


IF :GLOBAL.BTN = 2 THEN
:GLOBAL.STRD_ITEM_SEQ := NULL;
LAST_RECORD;

LOOP
IF :STRG_ITEMS.CHEK = 1 THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.STRD_ITEM_SEQ IS NULL THEN
 :GLOBAL.STRD_ITEM_SEQ := :STRG_ITEMS.STRD_ITEM_SEQ;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.STRD_ITEM_SEQ:= :GLOBAL.STRD_ITEM_SEQ|| ',' || :STRG_ITEMS.STRD_ITEM_SEQ;
 END IF;
END IF;

EXIT WHEN GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('STRG_ITEMS', CURRENT_RECORD) = 1;
PREVIOUS_RECORD;

END LOOP;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.STRD_ITEM_SEQ := :STRG_ITEMS.STRD_ITEM_SEQ ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHEK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION CHEK(P_STRD_ITEM_SEQ NUMBER,P_PORT_CD NUMBER,P_STRG_REQ_NBR NUMBER,P_STRG_REQ_DT DATE,P_OUT_REQ_NBR NUMBER,P_OUT_REQ_DT DATE)
RETURN NUMBER IS
TEMP_VAR NUMBER ;
OK_C NUMBER := 1 ;
REQ_NBR NUMBER;
REQ_DT DATE ;
BEGIN
 SELECT NVL(REPKG_REQ_NBR,0) INTO TEMP_VAR FROM BA_STRG_REQ_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD AND STRG_REQ_NBR = P_STRG_REQ_NBR AND
 STRG_REQ_DT = P_STRG_REQ_DT AND STRD_ITEM_SEQ = P_STRD_ITEM_SEQ;
 IF TEMP_VAR = 0 THEN
 SELECT PKGS_QTY_BALC INTO TEMP_VAR FROM BA_STRG_REQ_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD AND STRG_REQ_NBR = P_STRG_REQ_NBR AND
 STRG_REQ_DT = P_STRG_REQ_DT AND STRD_ITEM_SEQ = P_STRD_ITEM_SEQ;
 IF TEMP_VAR = 0 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO TEMP_VAR FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM BA_OUT_ITEMS WHERE
 PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD AND OUT_REQ_NBR = P_OUT_REQ_NBR AND
 OUT_REQ_DT = P_OUT_REQ_DT AND STRG_REQ_NBR = P_STRG_REQ_NBR AND
 STRG_REQ_DT = P_STRG_REQ_DT AND STRD_ITEM_SEQ = P_STRD_ITEM_SEQ);
 IF TEMP_VAR = 0 THEN
 SELECT OUT_REQ_NBR,OUT_REQ_DT INTO REQ_NBR,REQ_DT FROM BA_OUT_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD AND
 STRG_REQ_NBR = P_STRG_REQ_NBR AND
 STRG_REQ_DT = P_STRG_REQ_DT AND
 STRD_ITEM_SEQ = P_STRD_ITEM_SEQ AND
 ROWNUM < 2;
 MESSAGE('هذا الصنف تم إخراجه في طلب إخراج آخر برقم ' || REQ_NBR || ' بتاريخ ' || TO_CHAR(REQ_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 MESSAGE('هذا الصنف تم إخراجه في طلب إخراج آخر برقم ' || REQ_NBR || ' بتاريخ ' || TO_CHAR(REQ_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 --**DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_ID);
 OK_C := 0 ;
 --**RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO TEMP_VAR FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM BA_RPKG_RSLTD_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD AND STRG_REQ_NBR = P_STRG_REQ_NBR AND
 STRG_REQ_DT = P_STRG_REQ_DT AND STRD_ITEM_SEQ = P_STRD_ITEM_SEQ AND
 RSLTD_QTY_BALC > 0);
 IF TEMP_VAR = 0 THEN
 SELECT OUT_REQ_NBR,OUT_REQ_DT INTO REQ_NBR,REQ_DT FROM BA_OUT_ITEMS
 WHERE PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD AND
 STRG_REQ_NBR = P_STRG_REQ_NBR AND
 STRG_REQ_DT = P_STRG_REQ_DT AND
 STRD_ITEM_SEQ = P_STRD_ITEM_SEQ AND
 ROWNUM < 2;
 MESSAGE('هذا الصنف تم إخراجه في طلب إخراج آخر برقم ' || REQ_NBR || ' بتاريخ ' || TO_CHAR(REQ_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 MESSAGE('هذا الصنف تم إخراجه في طلب إخراج آخر برقم ' || REQ_NBR || ' بتاريخ ' || TO_CHAR(REQ_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 --**DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST(PL_ID);
 OK_C :=0 ;
 --** RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN OK_C ;
 END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);

 BEGIN
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;
